name: Emerald Eve Event Center
description: A rustic-industrial event center in Salem with an open hall, a built-in stage, lounge areas and a full commercial kitchen; tables, chairs, two arches and setup are included, packages are priced by guest count, and outside caterers are allowed.

seatedText:
Round tables 56–70
Banquet 100
Up to 150 seated

items.label: Description
items.value: A rustic-industrial event center in Salem with an open hall, a built-in stage, lounge areas and a full commercial kitchen; tables, chairs, two arches and setup are included, packages are priced by guest count, and outside caterers are allowed.

items.label: Price
items.value: Packages by guest count: Mini $100 to Extra Large $2,500

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Mini, 2-20 guests, 4 hours — $100 (renter cleans) or $300 (venue cleans)
Small, 20-50 guests, 4 hours — $400 (renter cleans) or $600 (venue cleans)
Medium, 50-100 guests, 6 hours — $1,000 (venue cleans)
Large, 100-150 guests, 6 hours — $1,500 (venue cleans)
Extra Large, 150-250 guests, 8 hours — $2,500 (venue cleans)
Extra hours — $20 to $160 per hour by package
$50 non-refundable booking fee
Electronics (microphone, projector, Xbox, stage lighting, TVs) — $50
Decor package — $150
Tablecloths — $100
Chair bows — $100
Cloth chair covers — $150
Kitchen items — $100
Kitchen appliances (stove, oven, heat lamp) — $200
Decorating services with venue decor — $200
Full decorating by venue staff — $250
Permission to bring alcohol — $200

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
$50 non-refundable booking fee
50% deposit to hold the date
Refunds: 100% at 60+ days; 50% under 60 days; none within 30 days
Up to $500 cleaning/security fee if the space is left damaged
Late check-out — $3 per minute

items.label: Indoors
items.value: Event hall (banquet, dance floor or ceremony layouts)

items.label: Seated
items.value:
Round tables 56–70
Banquet 100
Up to 150 seated

items.label: Included items
items.value:
Tables and chairs with setup and takedown
Indoor wooden hexagon arch
Outdoor metal arch outside the main doors
Ambient dimmable lighting
Aux cord for music
Cake table
Photo display easels
Basic kitchen access (fridge, freezer, ice machine, water dispensers)
Piano

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value:
Decorating services with venue decor — $200
Full decorating by venue staff — $250

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Venue cleans for Medium, Large and Extra Large packages
Mini and Small: renter cleans, or pay $200 more for venue cleaning
All renters follow a post-event checklist (trash out, spills cleaned)

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Built-in sound system, aux cord included
Electronics package — $50

items.label: For rent
items.value:
Decor package (lanterns, glass vases, votives, wood discs, metal items, easels, chalkboards, candles) — $150
Tablecloths — $100 per set of 10
Chair bows — $100
Cloth chair covers — $150
Light package — $100
Electronics (microphone, projector, Xbox, stage lighting, TVs) — $50

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Built-in stage
Lounge areas with couches
Large ice machine
Full commercial kitchen
Kitchen dining set — $100
Kitchen appliance use (stove, oven, grill, warming table) — $200
Kitchen cleaning deposit — $100 (refundable)

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Outside caterers welcome
No charge for kitchen space for pre-made food

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Full commercial kitchen (two ovens, stove, griddle, fridge, freezer)
Basic kitchen access included; stove/oven/grill use — $200

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
Permission to bring alcohol — $200 (staff supervision)
Licensed, insured bartending service required
No cash bars; drinks 15% ABV or less; hard liquor only in mixed drinks
$1,000 fine if alcohol is found without permission

items.label: Times
items.value:
4-hour block (Mini, Small)
6-hour block (Medium, Large)
8-hour block (Extra Large)

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Staple gun only on arches; no nails
No glitter or confetti
Nothing hung from ceilings, lights or the white wall behind the stage

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Packages priced by guest count; cleaning included from the Medium package up
Weekends are typically reserved for weddings
